predictionTarget: receiver task success on unseen attribute combinations
targetBoundary: The primary estimand is success differences on unseen combinations only. Seen-combination success is a reported secondary diagnostic, not the primary generalization claim.

family.memberProcedure: LG-G p-value is its maximum component p-value: the primary member is supported only if all four normal-minus-control differences clear their registered boundary on unseen combinations.
family.unit: independently trained dyad; average within receiver role, then equally across roles, then across dyads
family.test: one-sided seed-level Student t test of mean statistic greater than boundary
family.zeroSdRule: Return p=1 with flagged degenerate interval; do not divide by zero. A degenerate component must not make unrelated members inconclusive.
family.intervals: marginal two-sided 95% seed-level t intervals plus simultaneous one-sided component bounds at alpha 0.05/4
family.sensitivity: 10000-resample deterministic dyad bootstrap is descriptive only; never select the more favorable test
family.invaliditySensitivity: Report valid-only inference and descriptive worst-admissible-value bounds across every attempted dyad; do not claim missingness is ignorable.

secondaryInterventions.maskRule: Replace the masked position with a fixed null token while holding the other position, frozen state, and action draw constant.
secondaryInterventions.reverseRule: Swap the two token positions while holding frozen state and action draw constant.
secondaryInterventions.replacementRule: Replace each token with an independent uniform inventory draw from a dedicated stream.
secondaryInterventions.estimation: Report success and action-distribution changes on the same paired cases; estimate token-position/attribute associations from training records only.
secondaryInterventions.orderBoundary: Word-order sensitivity is not required for unordered compositional codes; a null reversal effect does not refute structure.

pilotAndPower.pilotReuse: No pilot/main reuse; no confirmatory reuse of LV01 or development outcomes.

selector.rule: Select the smallest qualifying N; if that N cannot be funded within the existing resource envelope, do not select a smaller underpowered N. Zero/nonfinite dispersion blocks this selection procedure.

pilotAndPower.reserveRule: One-sided 95% Wilson upper invalidity bound; smallest R giving P(Binomial(N+R,pUpper) <= R) >= 0.95 separately per main/repeat stage. Replacement consumes only ordered registered reserves; a depleted reserve pool closes the stage incomplete.
pilotAndPower.registrationRule: Fresh pilot, numerical qualification of the m=1/k=4 selector, capacity decision, and main/repeat registration are all required before collection. This draft performs none of them.

invalidity.rule: Frozen technical rules only: wrong source or configuration, partition contamination (including any held-out access during fitting or selection), missing required evidence, broken chronology or restoration, or execution abort.
invalidity.validObservations: Low success, high loss, slow convergence and inconvenient estimates remain valid.
invalidity.replacement: Replacement consumes only ordered registered reserves; a depleted reserve pool closes the stage incomplete.

interpretation.generalizationMember: A supported LG-G means all four registered normal-minus-control success differences clear 0.05 on unseen combinations: evidence that learned communication transfers to untouched combinations in this registered setting.
interpretation.structureBoundary: Neither the primary generalization test nor a token-position/attribute correlation score alone proves compositional grammar. Secondary part/order observations may suggest structure; the research answer may be that generalization occurs without evidence for a particular structural account.
interpretation.holisticControl: The separately trained holistic type-code/two-token control comparison is descriptive, not a causal claim isolating representation alone.
interpretation.nonRejection: Report not supported at the registered threshold; do not assert equivalence or no effect.
interpretation.e15Boundary: No LG01 result marks original E15 complete; its bandwidth estimand requires its own execution.

claimBoundary: This is a fixed deferred draft analysis plan, not a pilot result, selected N, resource authorization or finding.
